build.description: Builds the application in production mode.

run.description: Runs the application in production mode. Requires the application to be built first.

dev.description: Builds and runs the application in development mode, with hot reloading.

test-watch.description: Runs the tests in watch mode.

check.description: Checks the formatting and runs the linter.

git-rebase.description: Gets your branch up to date with master after a squash merge.
git-rebase.command: git fetch origin main && git rebase --onto origin/main HEAD

start-dev.command: docker compose ps --services | grep -q '^postgres-dev$' || (docker compose up -d --wait postgres-dev && deno task drizzle-kit migrate && deno task drizzle-kit push && deno run -A --env-file ./database/seeds/default.ts)

start-test.command: docker compose ps --services | grep -q '^postgres-test$' || (docker compose up -d --wait postgres-test && deno task drizzle-kit-test migrate && deno task drizzle-kit-test push && deno run -A --env-file --env-file=.env.test ./database/seeds/default.ts)

start.description: Starts the development and test services.
start.command: deno task start-dev && deno task start-test

stop.description: Stops the development and test services.
stop.command: deno task stop-dev ; deno task stop-test

drizzle-kit.description: Runs the drizzle-kit commands for the database.

drizzle-kit-test.description: Runs the drizzle-kit commands for the test database.

drizzle-kit:push.description: Pushes your drizzle schema to the development and test databases.
drizzle-kit:push.command: deno task drizzle-kit push ; deno task drizzle-kit-test push
